question: Does stronger selector supervision repair the observed multi-support TRAIN fitting gap without changing data or explicit answer/source loss weights?
motivation: V24 observed exact TRAIN support-set fits117/128,59/96,12/32 while TRAIN answers255/256. Low mixed-field teacher-forced CE was not reliable evidence of set fitting.

numerical_equivalence.limit: The intended loss coefficient still changes via protocol; this is source equivalence, not hardware qualification.

controls: Identical documents, native targets, order, schedule, LR, optimizer, topology, precision, source sampling, view allocation and source/final-answer coefficients.
Existing computational worker, batching, order and checkpoint functions are AST-identical; all non-driver numerical/packing sources match.
Only one new treatment model. Original V23 control/results remain unchanged. No new CoT baseline or architecture claim.

primary_fitting.cohort: Unchanged V24 fixed hash TRAIN256 with128/96/32 support-count strata.
primary_fitting.endpoint: Exact annotation-set agreement, separately by support count.
primary_fitting.pass_rule: At least90% exact in both two- and three-support strata, AND positive paired95% lower bound versus completed0.1 control in three-support stratum.
primary_fitting.CI: 20000 paired question bootstrap draws, seed2026101925, conditional on checkpoints; no pooled strata.
primary_fitting.checkpoint: Terminal256 only; step128 is resumable backup, not outcome-selected.

secondary: Answer fitting, selection precision/recall/F1, ID counts, duplicates, EOS/caps/errors, observed memory and compute.
If fitting target passes: fixed V23 held255 direct/selection/oracle plus ordinary256 prediction may be evaluated as developmental follow-up only.
Report net generated-answer change versus old matched direct and same-model direct with token costs; do not use the contaminated supplied-empty native condition.
held_interpretation: V23 held255 has already been inspected and motivated this ablation. Reuse is explicitly developmental, not untouched confirmatory evidence. No official DEV/TEST release.
allocation: No same-protocol replication, larger model, RL or broader campaign. A failed fitting ablation closes this coefficient hypothesis. A positive one requires separate generalization evaluation.

stages: Fresh-process full restore4 then updates5-8 with full saves6/8
qualification.independent_audit: All4 original full states, masks/counts, masters/moments/casts and restore4 bytes.

limits: Support annotations are imperfect, and exact annotation agreement is not semantic entailment.
One data-order seed cannot establish robustness. TRAIN fitting is not capability or generalization.
The explicit loss coefficient changes while clipping/optimizer dynamics can change as a consequence; do not call this matched gradient magnitude.
